subtitle: All Saints’ Day
collect: God of holiness, your glory is proclaimed in every age: as we rejoice in the faith of your saints, inspire us to follow their example with boldness and joy, through Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

notices.title: Shoebox Sunday
paragraphs: Worship for All in church and Shoe Box Sunday. We are collecting the Shoe boxes for Link to Hope at this service so please bring your filled shoeboxes along.

notices.title: Celebration of the life of Barry Moughton
paragraphs: There will be a service of celebration for the life of the late Barry Moughton at St Michael’s Church followed by a family Burial of Ashes in the churchyard. Al who knew Barry are welcome to join the family afterwards at The Running Horses. The service will be zoomed for those who would like to join virtually. The zoom code details are:

notices.title: Monday evening Bible study
paragraphs: The Monday evening Bible study group meets at Westhumble Chapel. Please contact Amanda on aewadsworth@hotmail.com if you would like more information about joining this group.

notices.title: The Alpha course
paragraphs: The Alpha course meets in The Ranmore Room (the vestry).

notices.title: Compline
paragraphs: Please note later date. Compline in church. All are welcome to come along for a short service and period of reflection, prayer and fellowship.

notices.title: Thursday morning Bible study
paragraphs: The Thursday morning Bible Study group meets at Westhumble Chapel. If you would like to join this group, please email admin@micklehamchurch.org.uk or call Alison Wood on 01372 376443 or 07905 985928.

notices.title: Coffee and cake at the Chapel
paragraphs: Coffee and cake at the Chapel in Westhumble. Only £2 and free drinks for children. Do come along and bring a friend or neighbour. Offers of homemade cakes or help on the morning appreciated. Contact Jonathan Blake: 07787 126966.

notices.title: Remembrance Sunday
paragraphs: Service in church for Remembrance Sunday, with Act of Remembrance around the war memorial at 11am. Afterwards we have been kindly invited to have refreshments at RGS-Surrey Hills School. There will not be an 8am Communion service at the Chapel on this Sunday.

Poppies will be available to buy in church. Payment can be made by cash or there is a QR code which connects directly to the collection being made in Mickleham and Westhumble for the Royal British Legion.

notices.title: A Concert for Remembrance Sunday
paragraphs: A Concert for Remembrance Sunday by Mickleham Choral Society in church. Tickets £15, children 12 years and under £7.50. Book tickets via Events page on www.micklehamchoral.org.uk. More information on page 6 of the October Parish Magazine.
notices.emphasis: Please note that the venue is incorrect in the magazine: the concert will be in St Michael’s Church not at the Village Hall

notices.title: PCC meeting
paragraphs: The PCC meets in the Ranmore Room.

notices.title: Lights to Remember
paragraphs: Lights to Remember service in church, when we will remember our loved ones who we have lost. See invitation attached to covering email.

notices.title: Ascending Deeper
paragraphs: Ascending Deeper evening on the topic of What does the Bible say about Migration? Please let Sandra know if you wish to come or want any information.

notices.title: Children’s Christmas Concert: The Snowman
paragraphs: There is a Children’s Christmas Concert ‘The Snowman’ in church followed by the lighting of the Christmas Trees outside the church and refreshments provided by the Church Community Group. There will be more information in the November Parish Magazine.
notices.emphasis: Please note that the Christingle Craft Workshop and Family Service will be on Sunday, 6th December.

notices.title: Autumn Soup Lunch
paragraphs: Autumn Soup Lunch in Mickleham Village Hall. Please make a note in your diaries of this remaining date for these popular lunches. Delicious homemade soups, bread and cheese and good company. No charge but donations gratefully received, with all proceeds going to local charities (including the Foodbank).
To help with numbers, please book your place with Andy Diamond by calling 07789 775354 or email him at adiamond714@gmail.com, or sign the list at the back of the church.

notices.title: Christingle Craft Workshop and Family Service
paragraphs: Please note that the Christingle Craft Workshop and Family Service will be on Sunday, 6th December.

features.title: The Nativity Journey at Wintershall — 15th to 20th December 2026
paragraphs: If you have never been to the Wintershall Nativity you may be interested in finding out more about the event. Wintershall is a private estate near Godalming which hosts a re-enactment of the Nativity story.

Attendees can discover the true meaning of Christmas with an unforgettable immersive event for all the family. They stand with the shepherds, walk with Mary, Joseph and the donkey, journey with Roman soldiers and enter the stable to watch the miracle unfold. See the flyer attached to covering email.
